target_customer: Clinics, provider groups, MSO and DSO organizations and health systems
problem: Clinic data is fragmented across systems and staff spend time on billing, referrals and scheduling instead of care, so eligible patients and revenue are missed.
business_model: B2B software deployed per organization, pricing not found

founders.name: Arya Khokhar
founders.background_notes: YC page lists research at Stanford Medicine and Caltech and YC Summer Fellow. A Stanford professor is mentioned as joining but is not listed as a founder.

competitors.name: Commure
competitors.what: AI agents for front office, claims and revenue cycle
competitors.traction_then: Claims 85 percent autonomous revenue cycle work (self-reported)

competitors.name: Epic native AI
competitors.what: AI built into the dominant EHR, with Agent Factory
competitors.traction_then: Epic says over 85 percent of customers use Epic AI

technical_complexity.rationale: Harmonizing data across many clinical systems and running workflows safely inside them is hard, especially for a team of two or three.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration could lock in customers but heavily funded rivals and the EHR vendors cover the same workflows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Epic and Commure were already shipping agents for the same workflows.

market_need_then: Administrative burden and revenue cycle spend in US healthcare are well documented; Eos claims support for 550+ physicians on its site (self-reported).

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and clinician-friendly; 'Practice medicine, not administration.'

brand_strength.rationale: Short name shared with Greek dawn goddess and other companies, no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Eos AI is a Winter 2026 company built around a single founder with Caltech and Stanford research roots. No outcome exists yet. The wedge is crowded by Epic and funded agent vendors, so execution speed and a design partner base will decide results.
notes: VCBacked and neuronfeed list 500K pre-seed or seed (Mar or Jan 2026) from YC only; unverified aggregators, no round recorded. Founding year 2025 per YC, one profile says 2026. YC lists team size 3 but one source says solo founder. Founder is described as a YC Summer Fellow.
